summary: Northern Trust Corporation filed a preliminary 424B5 prospectus supplement for a registered offering of two tranches of senior unsecured notes: % Senior Notes due 2031 and % Senior Notes due 2036, both non-redeemable prior to maturity and ranking equally with existing and future senior debt. Coupon, size and pricing are left blank in this preliminary filing; joint book-running managers are BofA Securities, Citigroup, Goldman Sachs, Morgan Stanley and Siebert Williams Shank, with settlement via DTC against payment around November 2026. This is a routine investment-grade debt takedown off an existing shelf, not a special situation; nothing to arbitrage.
